note: Written by tools/payo_export_unity.py from the owner-approved scene ArtSource/payo/payo_dressed_d53.blend (2026-10-18; frozen copy in ArtSource/payo/approved-2026-10-18). Unity axes. Positions are (x, y up, z north); yaw is degrees clockwise from above.
axes: EVERY PIECE IS A PLAIN glTF (y up, +z its front), copied unchanged. glTFast shows a glTF point (x, y, z) at Unity (-x, y, z): at yaw 0 a piece's FRONT faces +z (NORTH, the valley) and its glTF +x side is on the WEST. Place a piece at `position` with rotation (0, yaw, 0) and uniform `scale`: front = (sin yaw, cos yaw) in (x, z). The meshes made by the assembly (payo_land_*, payo_pit_floor) and the kept far pieces are already turned: place them at the origin with yaw 0. TEST (tools/payo_assemble.py axis, Logs/payo/assembly/axis_test.png): gate_portal at (0, -6, -49) yaw 0 has its stair toward the court and its sun disc facing north; house_shrine at (44.5, -6, 0) yaw 270 has its long stair toward the pit (west); block slabE with yaw 180 has its stepped carving on the EAST (outer) side, and stair_E with yaw 180 descends toward +x. 2026-10-18: the land is payo_land_x<i>_y<j> (256 m chunks of the layout frame, chunk i covering x 256 i .. 256 (i + 1), 'm' a minus), payo_land_low (the plain under everything) and the water ribbons payo_river, payo_water_stair, payo_inlet_water, payo_weir_water: all made here, already turned, placed at the origin with yaw 0. `scale3` (Unity localScale x, y, z) is given where a piece is NOT scaled uniformly (the cliff_wall run below the pit's open front is 1.35 tall); `scale` is then its x.

blocks_note: ONE MODEL PER BLOCK ID (the four corners share monolith). A model's origin is the centre of its block's COLLISION TOP and its top face is AT the origin: place it at (x, top - 0.01, z) WITH ROTATION (0, yaw, 0) -- the yaw is new and it matters: slabE, slabW, midE, bridgeE and most stones need their half turn or their carving faces inward, and BOTH STAIRS need yaw 180 or the ramp descends the wrong way under its collider. `extension` is a plain 40 m shaft with the same origin and yaw, starting 12.6 m down: hang it on the block so a raised block shows no foot. Where a layout makes a block a stair, draw `stair.model` (yaw `stair.yaw`) instead. 2026-10-18: models are the calm repaint (same names), yaws are the 10-12 assembly's (d53 turned them to face out, which put oblong and corner tops off their collision footprints). `dy` is d53's own height offset from (top - 0.01): every block a few millimetres apart so no two tops share a plane (they flickered, owner 2026-10-18); add it to the block's (and its extension's) y.
movers_note: Origin at the centre of the slab's top; place 1 cm under the collider's top at the mover's current (x, y, z).
pads_note: Origin on the floor at the layout's (x, y, z). pad_speed's travel is its +z: yaw 0 for +z, 180 for -z, 90 for +x, 270 for -x (unchanged: glTFast keeps z).

night.note: By day HIDE the nodes named in `nodes_lit_at_night` that end __flame (they are separate meshes inside fire_bowl, torch and hearth_pot) and draw __lantern and every *_glow material dim; from half time show the flames (breathe them), give each entry of `lights` a warm point light, and raise the emission of the glow materials (the turquoise inlay of the gate and the stage, the houses' windows). There is no separate flame placement any more and no group 'night'.

life_note: MODELS FOR THE GAME TO MOVE, each standing where it should begin, in the cast's manner (box heads, block bodies; all colour is vertex colour on py_flat and py_weave). They are rigid single meshes with no bones: sway, bob, slide or swap them as the other maps' ambient life does. `do` says what each should do. They are NOT in `placements`. Kinds: villager_stand, villager_watch, villager_carry, villager_plant, villager_sit, child_wave, carabao_stand, carabao_wallow, chicken, chicken_white, dog, egret, hawk. (2026-10-12 assembly: the 60 entries keep their kinds and models and stand on the new land: villagers and animals in the houses' yards, planters, egrets and the wallowing carabao in the nearer paddies, hawks over the valley.) (2026-10-18: carried over UNCHANGED from the 10-12 assembly; their positions stand on THAT land, not on land v59.)

catch.pivot: the body's origin is under its belly between the talons; it flies along local +Z in Unity (local -Y in Blender); each wing node's origin is its shoulder: flap by rotating the wing about its local Z (the body's long axis)
catch.note: talons hang 1.6 m under the origin: hold the player's shoulders there

vertex_colour: The land chunks (py_land_*: COLOR_0 the face's own colour, linear) and the court stone (py_court_stone), the calm terrace kit, the life figures and the kept trees carry vertex colour their materials multiply by; see `vertex_colour` per material in materials_payo.json. py_head_rock and the Lagoon and Eskinita plants do not.
collision: THE BUILDER STRIPS EVERY COLLIDER FROM THE ART; play is on the stage's own boxes inside the play walls (wallHalf 22 m) and nothing outside them is reachable. `collide: true` marks what should get a MeshCollider if that ever changes: the land chunks nearer than 300 m (the court platform's paving, the gorge's floor and the land round them), court_platform (platform paving, parapets, pit floor and walls, gorge), pool_basin, head_fall and the cliff_wall run. Not read by the builder yet.

land_lod.note: lod_tier on each land chunk: 0 full detail (any part nearer the can than 700 m), 1 decimated to 40% (to 1200 m), 2 to 22% beyond.

look: DAY (first half): a clear highland morning, the sun out over the valley to the north east at about 30 degrees, neutral to slightly warm key so the stone stays GREY, pale blue distance fog from about 120 m that takes the ranges one after another, cloud lying in the valley 50 m under the court. NIGHT (from half time): moonlight from the valley side, deep blue fog, warm fire light on the stage and the gate, Mayari over the far ridge.
